title: Ravensburger CreArt Enchanting Mermaids Paint by Numbers Kit

comparisons.notes: CreArt Junior Enchanting Mermaids, article 12023002, in stock; product photo matches Woot image (two mermaid boards)

writeup: Ravensburger's CreArt Enchanting Mermaids paint-by-numbers kit is $4.99 at Woot, versus $17.99 at Ravensburger's own US store. The junior set includes two mermaid boards with colored outlines and five ready-mixed acrylic paints, aimed at kids ages 5 to 7. An easy stocking stuffer at this price.
